summary: Narrowed lean-plan-compliance-check.sh's Goals-prose fallback harvest from a whole-range backtick sweep to a per-bullet leading-identifier-run (matching plan-format.md's documented contract and lean-challenge-snapshot.sh's sibling implementation), using possessive `\s*+` quantifiers to fix a PCRE backtracking artifact discovered live during verification that the plan's own literal plain-quantifier regex exhibited on prose-leading bullets. Re-baselined C13 (now skipped, SUPERSEDED) and C14/C15/C16 (rewritten into conformant shape), added regression cases C20 (C13's intent preserved on a conformant shape), C21 (the record's minimum verification bar) and C22 (first coverage of Challenge-Statements-preferred-harvest precedence), and corrected a stale fixture comment. Suite grew from 19 to 22 cases, all green; the sibling snapshot suite's 37 cases are unchanged. Batch Gate Deferral's scoped verify-touched.sh check passed clean on an untruncated re-run after a transient, tree-flux-attributed failure signal on the first (truncated) run.
